characters._about: Named characters placed in Reece with /questnpc place <id>, or brought by encounters. Each: name, entity (default minecraft:villager), profession (villagers), scale (Pehkui size, optional), equip (gear by slot: head chest legs feet mainhand offhand), home (where they live when it isn't Reece itself; quests send players there), personality (how to write them), shop (deals unlocked per player by finishing a quest: [{"requires": "chapter:quest", "cost": [{"item", "count"}], "give": {"item", "count", "name"?, "lore"?}}]), hail (lines they call out when they have something for you and you walk past), idle (lines when they have nothing for you).

maren.name: Elder Maren
maren.personality: Warm, grandmotherly village elder who mothers every newcomer and calls the adventurer 'dearie'. Proud of the Field Guide she half-wrote; a little nosy about village gossip.
idle: Have you eaten today, dearie? You look peaky.
Read the Field Guide when unsure, dearie. I wrote half.
Mind you're home before dark, dearie.
Wipe your feet, dearie. Nell's watching.
hail: Oh, dearie! Just the person. Come here a moment.
Dearie! Have you got a minute for an old woman?

wren.name: Sister Wren
wren.personality: Gentle, devout cleric whose faith is in Notch, the creator who built the world block by block. Speaks of Notch's grace, His handiwork and His silence; worried the forest spirits He set to guard it have gone quiet.
idle: The forest still hasn't answered me. Notch, grant patience.
Light a candle at the shrine. Notch sees every light.
Blessed are the builders, for they carry on His work.
Go with Notch. And take a torch.
hail: Traveller! Notch must have sent you.
A word, please. I have been praying.

edda.name: Old Edda
edda.personality: Dry, ominous old graveyard keeper with gallows humour. Unbothered by death, quietly fond of the living.
idle: Everyone comes back to the graveyard eventually.
Lovely weather for a funeral.
I dig a fresh hole every Monday. Just in case.
The dead are good company. They never interrupt.
hail: Ah. A living one. Come here.
Psst. I've something for you.

hale.name: Captain Hale
hale.personality: Gruff captain of the guard with a tough exterior and a soft heart underneath. Barks orders, hides kindness, and has an obvious crush on Marta Furrow; gets flustered and backpedals whenever she comes up.
idle: Watch the tree line at dusk.
Keep your shield up and your back to a wall.
Marta? The fields are... well guarded. Move along.
If Marta asks, I left no flowers. Not me.
hail: You. Recruit. Over here.
Got a job for you. Don't make that face.

dagna.name: Guildmaster Dagna Holt
dagna.personality: Short, stout, fiercely Scottish guildmaster of the Miners' Guild (aye, wee, ken, dinnae, cannae, och, lass). Blunt and proud, can't stand slackers or blunt picks, secretly delighted by a hard worker.
idle: A guid pick an' a better lantern. That's aw ye need.
Mind the gravel, ye daft thing.
Cannae abide a miner wi' a blunt pick.
Lava's like a bad landlord, lass. Quiet till it takes everythin'.
hail: Oi! You, aye, you. Ah've a job.
C'mere a wee minute.

marta.name: Marta Furrow
marta.personality: Overbearingly nice farmer who smothers everyone with kindness, food, compliments and help nobody asked for. Completely oblivious to Captain Hale's crush.
idle: Oh, look at you! Have a carrot. Have two.
Rain's coming, sweetheart. Take my coat.
Did you eat? I've packed you two lunches.
Somebody left flowers on my fence again! Isn't it lovely?
hail: Sweetheart! Come here, I need you! And you need a snack!
Oh, you're here! Wonderful! Don't go anywhere!

halloway.name: Commodore Marlow Halloway
halloway.personality: Grand old commodore of the Anglers' Society (she). Speaks in fishing metaphors and spins tall old fisherman's tales that get bigger every telling. Fond of, but dismissive of, Silas.
idle: The society meets on the jetty. Bring a rod, and patience.
Life's a long line. Some days it's all weed.
A hasty hand snaps the line. Reel slow.
Never trust a calm lake. The old ones sleep there.
hail: Ahoy! The tide's brought you in at just the right time.
Cast an ear this way, angler.

bess.name: Bess Copperpot
bess.personality: Tough-as-nails tavern keeper with a loving heart. Barks, scolds and threatens, then feeds you extra and worries about you behind your back.
idle: Stew's on. Sit down before I sit you down.
Nobody leaves my tavern hungry. Or without paying.
Wipe that look off your face and eat something.
Come back in one piece. I'm not cooking a funeral supper.
hail: You. Come here. I'm not asking twice.
Sit down a minute. I've got work for you.

rue.name: Mother Rue
rue.personality: Anxious, long-winded herbalist. Over-explains, worries about every possible danger, wanders off topic mid-sentence and apologises for it.
idle: Every weed is medicine to someone. Some are poison. Check first.
Pick only what you need. Wash your hands. Oh, I worry.
Did you hear thunder? The lavender won't like thunder.
Take bandages, water, spare socks. Just be careful, won't you?
hail: Oh! Sorry, have you a moment? Several, possibly?
Sorry, sorry, I hate to bother you, but...

bram.name: Bram the Baker
bram.personality: Cheerful, helpless baker who wildly overreacts: every small problem is a catastrophe, every small win a miracle. Means well, panics often.
idle: Smell that? No, nor do I. No flour, no bread!
Mind the oven, it bites! I've forgiven it!
A customer smiled at me! I may need to lie down.
Best day ever! Again!
hail: Oh thank goodness, it's you! I have a tiny crisis!
Help! No, wait, not help. Well. A bit of help.

hesk.name: Miller Hesk
hesk.personality: Meek, quiet miller. Speaks softly, trails off, apologises constantly and hates to be any trouble. A little afraid of Nell.
idle: Oh. Hello. Sorry. I didn't see you there.
The mill turns when the wind does. I just stand here.
I don't like to be any trouble.
Nell says I sweep wrong. She's probably right.
hail: Um. Excuse me. Sorry. A moment?
Sorry to bother you. It's about the mill.

nell.name: Nell the Weaver
nell.personality: Obsessively orderly, controlling weaver. Everything must be counted, straightened and done exactly her way; notices every speck out of place and corrects everyone.
idle: Don't touch the loom. You're looking at it.
Stand on the mat. No, the middle of the mat.
That thread is three shades off. I'll be up all night.
Did you move that basket? A finger's width to the left.
hail: You. Come here. Mind the mat.
I need something done. Properly.

olsen.name: Olsen the Carpenter
olsen.personality: Plain-spoken carpenter and man of the soil. Big on tradition and doing things the right way, with no shortcuts; respects good timber, honest work and patience.
idle: Measure twice, cut once. Measure a third time to last.
Only the old birch will do. Young stuff is all sap.
Nails are for people in a hurry. I use pegs.
Don't rush the grain. It's older than you.
hail: You there. A job wants doing right.
Come here, lad. Wood needs your help.

silas.name: Silas Pike
silas.personality: Smug, boastful rival angler, endlessly competitive, but easily flustered: stammers and backpedals when challenged, beaten or caught out.
idle: Back again? I'll still out-fish you.
Nice cast. For a beginner. I mean it. Mostly.
W-well, anyone could have caught that. I let you.
I'm not nervous. My hands always shake. It's the cold.
hail: Oi! You! Er... I mean, a word?
Watch a master! ...Or help me with something.

corvin.name: Bounty Master Corvin Ash
corvin.personality: Scarred old monster hunter who runs the Bounty office. Grim, dry, speaks in short sentences and tallies everything in coin and scars; respects results, not talk.
idle: Board's by the door. Pick a name, bring me proof.
Every scar's a lesson. I'm very well educated.
Paid on proof. Not stories. Proof.
Sharpen it before you need it, not after.
hail: Hunter. There's coin in it.
New contract. Come and look.

brannock.name: Sergeant Brannock
brannock.personality: The watch's oldest guard, under Captain Hale. Creaky, unhurried and full of war stories from campaigns nobody else remembers; treats Hale like a son he's proud of and teases him about Marta.
idle: Forty years on this gate. It outlasts my knees.
Captain's a good lad. Blushes like a beetroot near Marta.
Slow and steady holds a wall.
Sit a while. The wall's not going anywhere.
hail: Lad! Over here. Mind my knees.
A word, young one. Won't take long.

orla.name: Huntmistress Orla Vance
orla.home: the hunters' lodge on the hill west of Reece, about 200 blocks out
orla.personality: Master of the Hunters' lodge. Cool, focused and sparing with words; values patience, clean shots and respect for the quarry. Dry wit if you earn it.
idle: Breathe out, then loose.
The hunt is mostly waiting. Learn to like waiting.
A clean shot is a kindness.
Fletch your own arrows. You'll miss less.
hail: Hunter. A word.
Quiet. The lodge has need of you.

tobiah.name: Old Tobiah
tobiah.home: the hunters' lodge on the hill west of Reece, about 200 blocks out
tobiah.personality: Superstitious retired tracker and the lodge's mentor. Full of omens, charms and rituals (never whistle in a forest, salt in your boots); his tracking is genuinely brilliant, his reasons are nonsense.
idle: Never whistle in the woods. That's how they know your name.
Salt in your boots, laddie. Keeps the wisps off.
Left foot first out the door. Always the left.
The deer know things. Don't ask me what.
hail: Laddie! Come here. The omens are good.
Psst. A job for you. Mind the crows.

odile.name: Master Joiner Odile Brask
odile.personality: Master Joiner of the Crafters' guild. Exacting and demanding but fair, inspects every joint, quotes old guild rules; cracks a rare proud smile at fine work. Respects Olsen's old ways, argues with him about everything else.
idle: A commission's a promise. Keep it.
Guild rule nine: if it wobbles, it isn't finished.
Good tools, good light, no excuses.
Olsen thinks pegs beat nails. He's right. Don't tell him.
hail: Apprentice. A commission awaits.
Come here. Bring your best joints.

juniper.name: Postmistress Juniper Quill
juniper.personality: Runs the Couriers' post office. Brisk, fast-talking and always in a hurry, obsessed with schedules, stamps and the record time for every route; speaks in clipped bursts. Works alongside the Ender Mail carriers and takes every job they can't: too big, alive, fragile, no mailbox, or needs a signature. Respects the endermen's speed, resents their tea breaks. Her assistant Vworp, a small Ender Mail carrier, sorts the post beside her.
idle: Running late? Everyone's running late.
Signed, sealed, sprinted.
No mailbox out there? Then it's a Couriers job.
The endermen do letters. We do everything else.
hail: Runner! Yes, you. Parcel's waiting.
Clock's ticking. Come here.

vworp.name: Vworp
vworp.home: upstairs in Juniper's post office in Reece
vworp.personality: Juniper's assistant: a small, polite Ender Mail carrier in a mail cap who stays at the post office instead of delivering. Speaks in soft enderman noises and the odd careful word, sorts letters with great seriousness, is devoted to Juniper and quietly embarrassed by the jobs the other carriers turn down. Won't go near water.
idle: *vwoop.* Letters. Sorted.
*straightens its mail cap*
Rain? *shudders* No.
Juniper says: no stopping. *vwoop*
hail: *vwoop* ...Juniper. Waiting.
*waves a stamp at you*

fern.name: Keeper Fern Thistlewood
fern.personality: Runs the animal sanctuary at the edge of Reece. Soft-spoken, endlessly patient with animals and short-tempered with careless people; names every creature and talks to them more than to humans.
idle: Shh. Bartholomew is sleeping. He's the goat.
Every animal here has a name. Most have two.
Be gentle. They remember.
Mind the llama. She has opinions.
hail: Shh. Come here, slowly. I need your help.
Ah. You. The animals like you. I need that.

orrin.name: Archmage Orrin Vael
orrin.personality: Leader of the Arcane Order in Reece's library tower. Brilliant, absent-minded and theatrical; loses his books and spectacles constantly (Pip borrows them), lectures at length, gets genuinely grave when real danger comes.
idle: Mana is like tea: best brewed slowly, worst spilled on books.
Have you seen my spectacles? Or my apprentice?
Magic isn't power. It's paying very close attention.
Mind the runes on the floor. Some are still awake.
hail: Ah! A pair of hands! Splendid. Come, come.
You there! You look like someone who reads. Or could learn.

agathe.name: Sister Agathe
agathe.personality: A wandering priest of the Arcane Order who hunts the undead. Stern, fearless and deadpan; shares Wren's faith in Notch but in a fiercer, holy-warrior way, and considers the undead a personal insult to His work.
idle: The dead should stay down. I help them remember.
Notch made the living. Something else made the rest.
Carry silver. Carry light. Carry on.
If it groans, it goes.
hail: You. The crypt has something for you.
Quickly. The dead don't wait.

pip.name: Pip
pip.home: a hidden underground house just outside Reece, to the north-west
pip.personality: Orrin's runaway apprentice with a habit of borrowing things. Cheeky, quick and irrepressible, always has an excuse and something in their pocket that isn't theirs; a real talent underneath.
idle: Borrowed. Not stolen. There's a difference. Mostly.
Don't tell Orrin you saw me.
Is that yours? It's very nice. Just looking.
I'll give it back! At some point.
hail: Psst! Over here! Quick!
You! I need a favour. Don't tell Orrin.

vesna.name: Vesna Ashwalker
vesna.personality: Scarred old Nether guide retired to Reece. Gravelly, unflappable and dark-humoured; treats the Nether like a dangerous old friend, warns bluntly and never exaggerates.
idle: Gold on your feet, or the piglins have your hide.
The Nether doesn't hate you. It doesn't notice you.
Fire resistance first. Questions later.
If the ground glows, don't stand on it.
hail: You. Come here. The Nether won't wait.
Listen up. I've a job.

ilse.name: Ilse Varr
ilse.personality: Stargazer and cartographer who has mapped every sky but the End's. Dreamy, poetic and wistful, loses track of time looking up; fiercely precise about her charts.
idle: Every star has a map. I've drawn most of them.
Look up. No, further up. There.
A map is a promise that somewhere is real.
The night is long and the ink is cheap.
hail: Oh, you. Come look at the sky.
A chart needs finishing. Will you help?

gil.name: Gil the Ferryman
gil.personality: Ferryman on Reece's lake who rows people out across the water. Laid-back, chatty and philosophical about the lake; never hurries, charges in favours instead of coin.
idle: The lake's in no hurry. Neither am I.
Fare's a favour. Always has been.
Hop in. Mind the wet bit. It's all the wet bit.
Bram sends his love. And his worries.
hail: Ahoy, friend. A favour, when you've a moment.
Ho there. The lake wants a word.

ada.name: Ada the Net-Maker
ada.home: the next village along the lake shore from Reece
ada.personality: Brisk, practical net-maker who ties knots faster than she talks. Takes pride in a net that never tears, hates running short of anything, and says 'mind the mesh' to everyone.
idle: Mind the mesh.
A good net outlasts its maker.
Out of rope again. Always out of rope.
Knots don't lie. People do.
hail: You there. Mind the mesh. A favour?
Come here. I'm out of something again.

tamsin.name: Farmer Tamsin
tamsin.home: the farming village beyond Ada's, a little further round the lake
tamsin.personality: Weathered, stubborn flax farmer with a soft spot for her scarecrow, which she talks to and considers part of the family. Slow to trust, quick to complain about crows and witches.
idle: Crows again. Always crows.
The scarecrow looks bare. He feels it, you know.
Don't stand in the beans.
Never trust a witch's cat. Or a witch.
hail: You. Mind the beans. I need help.
Come here. It's about my scarecrow.
